market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure from oil-driven inflation fears, RBA rate repricing, and property sector weakness. Geopolitical oil spike supports energy but weighs on transport and rate-sensitive sectors. Gold and critical minerals provide relative outperformance. Qantas strike risk and developer distress add idiosyncratic volatility. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a narrow, risk-off range.
market_outlook.long_term: Critical minerals (gold, rare earths, uranium) and AI infrastructure offer structural growth. Property correction may extend 6–12 months given credit contraction and tax policy changes. Energy mix debate (coal, nuclear, renewables) will drive policy volatility. Consumer shift toward weight-loss drugs, EVs, and value brands reshapes retail and healthcare. RBA likely to hold or hike, keeping AUD firm but pressuring growth equities.
